name: The Vellescian Gambit
source:
Play the role of a merchant's apprentice in this 1600s-inspired realistic setting full with trading companies and business ploys. A short (2-3h) but replayable visual novel/RPG with logistics and trading aspects, brought to life with beautiful baroque paintings and classical music.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1780520/The_Vellescian_Gambit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个以17世纪为灵感、充满贸易公司与商业谋略的写实世界中，扮演商人的学徒。这部篇幅约两至三小时、适合反复游玩的视觉小说兼角色扮演游戏，融合物流与贸易要素，以精美的巴洛克绘画与古典音乐，让世界鲜活呈现。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1780520/The_Vellescian_Gambit/]Steam[/url]]
